newsitem.title: FRANCE: RP Rorer has "no comment" on recall costs.
newsitem.headline: RP Rorer has "no comment" on recall costs.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said it had no comment on the total cost of the recall of albumin products by the Centeon LLC joint venture with Hoechst until its 1996 results due on Monday.
"We have no comment ahead of the results," a Rhone-Poulenc Rorer spokeswoman in Paris said.
Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, majority-owned by Rhone-Poulenc, will publish its full year results on Monday, January 27 at around 0700 GMT.
Earlier on Friday, Centeon LCC said it had resumed production following Food and Drugs Administration approval.

Rhone-Poulenc finance director Jean-Pierre Tirouflet said on October he expected the total impact of the recall to be between 100 and 200 million francs in 1996 and he did not exclude further charges in 1997.
